preconditions.description: Number of cities is between 2 and 50,000.
Old and new capital indices are distinct and within the range of city indices.
The length of the old road map representation is n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in p)
preconditions.description: Each city index in the old road map is within the range of city indices.

postconditions.description: The length of the new road map representation is n - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each city index in the new road map is within the range of city indices.

postconditions.expression: all(pi == r2 or pi in path_to_r2 for pi in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each city index in the new road map is either the new capital or part of the path to the new capital.
